Hi team — forwarding the technical answers to include in the TOMs exhibit and to share with SecureBank infra:

1) Supported wrapping/transport: RSA-OAEP-SHA256 (recommended) and AES-KW (RFC 3394) for wrapped keys. We support 2048/3072 RSA and AES-256 keys for the data key and master key layers.

2) HSM vendor/attestation: Redwood uses a FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM (vendor: SafeCrypt HSM 740) in our Dedicated pools. We can provide a vendor attestation letter and the HSM model/firmware version as an attachment on request.

3) Runtime KV eviction/rotation: key rotation is staged — new master keys get rotated and a per-tenant rewrap of data keys happens asynchronously. In-flight KV caches are versioned; we perform a TTL-based eviction (default 5 minutes) and a forced eviction during rotation windows. We provide rotation logs (timestamped rewrap events) and a token invalidation event stream on request.

4) Subprocessors and telemetry: inference telemetry is collected for performance tuning and is pseudonymized by default. No vendors receive unredacted PII in Hosted mode. For Dedicated or BYOK deployments where telemetry forwarding is enabled, we will provide a segregated pipeline and explicit subprocessors list and obtain customer approval before enabling.

5) Export controls / transfers: we support EU data residency options plus an SCC-backed transfer model. We'll provide our transfer impact statement and export-control clause text for the DPA appendix.

Attachments (for SecureBank): network-flow-diagram.png (high-level), byok-keyflow.txt (step sequence), sample-rotation-log.csv (sanitized). Please let me know if infra wants deeper logs or a live demo during the call.
